data.content:
It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that Liverpool have Alexander Isak to thank for the majority of their points this season. With 11 goals scored so far, the Reds definitely need improvement in the final third.

Alexander Isak has scored six of those 11 Premier League goals so far, often providing the winning piece of the puzzle.

## MFT's X-pert tip: Liverpool win & under 4.5 goals

Liverpool's attacking performances make them favourites at Selhurst Park, although their recent results suggest a high-scoring victory is far from guaranteed. [...] Crystal Palace are enduring a miserable run in the league. The Eagles have failed to score in their last three Premier League outings, suffering damaging defeats against Tottenham (2-0), Newcastle United (2-0), and a humiliating 5-0 thrashing away at Brighton.

While a midweek 1-1 draw against Hoffenheim in the Europa League provided a minor morale boost, their domestic form is a massive cause for concern.
